sources.title: Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth and a Ton More Square Enix Games Are on Sale for Black Friday
sources.text: Black Friday sales have featured some genuinely great gaming deals so far . That's especially true for Square Enix titles. Sure, GTA 6 may be keeping many of us busy right now, but if your physical gaming library is in need of a little refresh it's hard to pass up some of these offers, including Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth on PS5 down to just $15 and a first-time discount on the Kingdom Hearts Collection [I–III] on Switch 2. This Kingdom Hearts Collection only just came out in October, so it's very exciting to see its price drop as part of the sale event. It's a pretty solid $15 discount as well, which is definitely welcome if you've been wanting it for your Switch 2 library. Final Fantasy 7 Remake Intergrade and Rebirth are some of the other standout offers for Black Friday right now. PS5 versions of both games are just $15 a piece, which is the lowest we've ever seen them. Switch 2 versions, on the other hand, are a tiny bit higher, but not by much. Remake Intergrade is down to $20 while Rebirth is $25, so you're still scoring huge deals on them compared to their MSRPs. Similar to the Kingdom Hearts Collection, another recent release included in the sale this year is The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales , which came out just a few months ago back in June. According to our research, this Black Friday price is the lowest it's hit so far, bringing it just under $43 for a Switch 2 copy. Of course, there's quite a few more game deals to look through that we've highlighted above, including Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake on Nintendo Switch down to $21.24 and Life is Strange: Reunion on Xbox Series X down to $23.74. If something catches your eye, be quick to add it to your cart before it sells out. While these Square Enix games have been a real treat in Black Friday sales so far, they're not the only deals we've come across. We've been gathering up some of the best offers across PS5 , Xbox , and Nintendo so you can save on gaming goodies for your preferred platform. Check them out, and stock up on your favorite finds while they're still available. Hannah Hoolihan is a freelancer who writes with the commerce team here at IGN.

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: PS5 Games on Sale for $15 for Black Friday
sources.text: In the olden days (a few years ago) you had to wait until the actual day of Black Friday before the killer deals would crop up. Those days are officially gone. Today, on the Monday before Black Friday official, Walmart kicked off its “ Black Friday Event 2 ,” dropping some absolutely killer deals, and Amazon is price matching most of them. Among the discounts are a bunch of PS5 games on sale for just $15. These games are excellent and not that old. So grab what you want, because you’re not likely to find them cheaper any time soon. What games are we talking? For starters, Mafia: The Old Country, an excellent single-player game that came out last year that our reviewer called “an effective return to the linear and tightly story-driven format of the original Mafia and Mafia II.” Then there’s Assassin’s Creed Shadows , in which Ubisoft’s long-running series finally goes to Japan. We gave it an 8/10 in our review , saying, “By sharpening the edges of its existing systems, Assassin’s Creed Shadows creates one of the best versions of the open-world style it’s been honing for the last decade.” Then there’s Borderlands 4 and Star Wars Outlaws and WWE 2K26, all fine games worth checking out if you haven’t already. Fifteen bucks will even get you Elden Ring, Fromsoft’s sprawling, open-world masterpiece that we gave a 10/10 in our review when it came out in 2022. That same year, we awarded it Game of the Year . Other all-time low prices can be had now as well, like AirPods Pro 3 for $149 and Metal Gear Solid Master Collection Vol 2. for $29.99 . Chris Reed is a senior commerce editor and deals expert for IGN. He also runs IGN's LEGO coverage and maintains the upcoming release dates articles for video games , LEGO sets , and 4K Blu-rays . You can follow him on Bluesky .

sources.text: Grand Theft Auto VI supports XBOX Cloud Gaming , making it available to play even without a current-gen console. With XBOX Cloud Gaming, you can play by streaming it straight from the cloud to your XBOX One, or XBOX Series X|S if you’d like to save some hard drive space. Select Game Pass plans include a monthly allotment of up to 15 play hours, and you can buy more cloud playtime if you need it, giving you the opportunity to experience one of the biggest games of the year on the consoles you already own. The game uses XBOX Series S graphics settings when cloud-streamed with XBOX Cloud Gaming. You can also access Remote Play to enjoy Grand Theft Auto VI wherever you want to play , allowing you to stream gameplay directly from your XBOX Series X|S console to devices you already own, like your mobile phone, laptops, PCs, or even a handheld gaming PC like the XBOX ROG Ally. sources.name: PlayStation Blog
sources.title: Thank you for making Grand Theft Auto VI the biggest launch in PlayStation history
sources.text: Celebrating the PlayStation community and Rockstar Games for creating an incredible moment in gaming and entertainment. After a long wait, players finally have had the chance to jump into Grand Theft Auto VI . It’s been amazing to see the PlayStation community around the world begin their adventures in the state of Leonida. Whether you’ve been counting down the days to return to the streets of Vice City or you’re experiencing the Grand Theft Auto series for the very first time, we want to take a moment to say: thank you. The excitement and passion of the community have made this a truly special moment for all of us. The launch of GTAVI marks an extraordinary moment for gaming and entertainment, becoming the biggest game launch in PlayStation history, across three decades and five console generations. More than 39 million unique players have experienced Jason and Lucia’s story in Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5. The PlayStation community came together in a big way to experience Grand Theft Auto VI during its launch and opening weekend. Here are a few highlights from the launch window ending November 22, 2026*: These are just a few ways we’ve seen our PlayStation community come together around this incredible moment in gaming, and we’re excited to see how you continue to build and share new memories and experiences in the months ahead. Finally, we want to congratulate our partners at Rockstar Games for bringing this extraordinary game to players around the world and continuing a partnership with PlayStation that stretches back to Grand Theft Auto III on PlayStation 2. With GTAVI, we worked to bring the best experience on PS5 and gave players a memorable way to commemorate the game with two special limited-edition DualSense wireless controllers inspired by Vice City. We also celebrated the launch with live events including Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival in Miami this past weekend. And to our PlayStation community, thank you for your continued passion and support, and for choosing to experience GTAVI on PS5 . It’s your enthusiasm that make moments like these so meaningful for all of us. We can’t wait to see where your adventures in Leonida take you next! *All figures are based on SIE internal data collected from November 19, 2026, to November 22, 2026

sources.title: GTA 6 was the ‘biggest launch in PlayStation history’ with over 39 million players
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 was “the biggest launch in PlayStation history,” according to Sony, with over 39 million users playing the game on PS5. According to a post on the PlayStation blog, players cumulatively logged 683 million hours of gameplay in GTA 6 between launch and November 22. The game also set a new record for concurrent players of a single game on PlayStation consoles. PlayStation also claims that the platform holder “saw the largest number of newly connected PS5 consoles on a single day since the consoleâs launch, outside of end-of-year holidays.” GTA 6 was also “the first game played on 70% of new PS5 consoles” during the period of launch until November 22. This comes after Rockstar and publisher Take-Two announced that Grand Theft Auto 6 has become the most successful launch for any piece of media in history, after being pre-ordered over 32 million times. On Friday, Rockstar and Take-Two claimed that the game has generated $3.79 billion in day one retail sales, “setting a new record for entertainment across any medium, and becoming the biggest entertainment launch in history.” For comparison, Spider-Man : Brand New Day generated $2.5 billion across its entire theatrical run as the highest grossing film of the year. When compared to other GTA titles, GTA 5 generated $815 million on launch day, which means GTA 6 managed almost 5 times as much. Grand Theft Auto 6 released on Thursday November 19, 13 years after the previous entry in the franchise. Upon release, the game achieved a record-tieing 99 out of 100 on Metacritic , making it one of the highest rated games of all time. VGC’s Grand Theft Auto 6 review calls it “the game of the generation”, saying Rockstar “delivers its modern masterpiece with a remarkable artistic achievement that exceeds all expectations”. sources.title: God of War Laufey's Faye actor jumps from games to live-action, as Amazon casts Deborah Ann Woll in upcoming series
sources.text: After appearing in both God of War Ragnarok and next year's God of War Laufey, Deborah Ann Woll is about to reprise her role as Faye in Amazon Prime Video's upcoming live-action series. Variety reports that the God of War cast list is now welcoming a second actor pulled straight from Sony Santa Monica's video game series. Deborah Ann Woll first showed up in the games as Kratos' wife and Atreus' mother during God of War Ragnarok, but she's also about to enter the spotlight proper in God of War Laufey. Amazon's God of War cast now includes Dave Bautista (Guardians of the Galaxy) as god killer Kratos, Callum Vinson (Chucky) as Atreus, Mandy Patinkin as Odin and Ólafur Darri Ólafsson as Thor. Alastair Duncan is also making the game-to-show jump by stepping back into the figurative shoes of chatty head Mimir. Earlier in the year, the God of War show halted production when former Kratos actor Ryan Hurst suffered an on-set injury. Bautista soon took over the role and production began again in October - all of Hurst's scenes had to be reshot, of course. There's no release date yet for the show, but it's said to follow the Norse era of the games which began in 2018's more serious and stern revamp. Amazon ordered a two-season run for the show, which apparently means both seasons will be filmed back-to-back. Meanwhile, God of War Laufey was recently delayed from February 2027 to May 2027, giving the PS5 exclusive slightly more breathing room away from Fable, Persona 4 Revival and Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis. "We will make the most of each moment until then by putting in the finishing touches and pushing the game to its fullest potential," developer Sony Santa Monica said at the time. "On behalf of everyone on the team, we appreciate your patience and we'll be back to share more updates soon." While the game puts Faye in the leading role as she battles with gods in a multi-mythological afterlife, the studio was quick to note that her journey isn't considered a side game. God of War Laufey will still connect to future games in the series and, yep, Kratos will eventually be back , too. "Genuinely, I thought I was going to be much more offended by it, but one, I'm not on social media, so that helps, and two, I don't know, I feel totally unbothered," Woll said of the online trolls who were targeting Laufey after its reveal this summer. "Because I just know it's great. It's okay if it's not your cup of tea, but in no universe is it bad."

sources.title: Acts of Blood for PC delayed to spring 2027
sources.text: Publisher Big Fan Games and developer Eksil Team have delayed beat ’em up action game Acts of Blood from its previously planned December 4, 2026 release to spring 2027 for PC via Steam and Microsoft Store . PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series versions are also due out in 2027. Here is the full message from Eksil Team on the delay: With heavy heart we’re making a difficult decision to postpone the release of the game on PC (Steam) into spring 2027. We know the decision might disappoint for you, whom already looking forward to play our game on December. But after assessing the feedback we got from players, play testers, and internal team, we found several issues that still can be improved with a little bit more time, and hopefully it will deliver the best experience we intended.

sources.title: GTA 6 ganha primeira atualização no PS5 e Xbox! Veja o que muda
sources.text: GTA 6 é bom? Confira a review do aguardado Grand Theft Auto VI Apenas alguns dias após a grande estreia, GTA 6 já recebeu uma nova atualização no PS5 e Xbox Series X|S que corrige problemas no sistema de salvamento automático — além de outros erros relatados pelos jogadores. O patch, que já está disponível para download, tem cerca de 603 MB e leva o jogo para a versão 01.002.002. Entre as mudanças, a Rockstar também corrigiu falhas que impediam a perda do nível de procurado e o acionamento correto de algumas ligações telefônicas. A atualização ainda resolve problemas de travamento e outros erros que afetavam diferentes atividades do jogo. Desde o lançamento de GTA 6 , os jogadores têm relatado dificuldades com o sistema de salvamento automático. Em alguns casos, os problemas teriam resultado até na perda de dados, fazendo com que parte do progresso nas primeiras horas de jogo desaparecesse. Embora o título salve automaticamente após missões principais e algumas atividades secundárias, o recurso aparentemente não estava funcionando de maneira consistente. Inclusive, houve relatos de jogadores que concluíram missões importantes, mas não tiveram o progresso registrado corretamente. A Rockstar afirma que corrigiu o problema na atualização mais recente, que também resolve outras falhas relacionadas à progressão. Entre elas, estavam erros que impediam o acionamento de ligações importantes para avançar na história ou desbloquear conteúdos de missões. Além de instalar o patch, vale conferir se o salvamento automático está funcionando normalmente. Por precaução, também é recomendável pausar o jogo e salvar o progresso manualmente sempre que possível. Confira as notas completas da atualização: Embora tenha sofrido review bomb da comunidade recentemente, GTA 6 é sem sombra de dúvidas o maior jogo de todos os tempos — não apenas pela sua escala monumental, mas também pelo impacto cultural que vem causando desde seu período de pré-lançamento. Mesmo gigante de diferentes formas possíveis, o game tem uma reprodução bastante assertiva nos consoles . Para aqueles que desejam a cobiçada platina do jogo, saibam que GTA 6 possui uma lista com mais de 50 troféus/conquistas para desbloquear . Além de um mapa interativo que pode te ajudar muito na jogatina, o título também conta com uma série de cheats e trapaças — mas que são ativáveis de forma diferente em comparação aos games anteriores da franquia. E você, já está jogando GTA 6 ? Conte nas redes sociais do VOXL se também enfrentou problemas com o salvamento automático do jogo! sources.title: GTA 6 Motion Capture Actor Has No Idea Who He Is in the Game, Sparks Social Media Hunt to Find His Character
sources.text: One GTA 6 actor has no idea who he plays and has asked for fans to help him find his character in the game. Guy A. Fortt, who has previously played a guard in Jessica Jones and The Sopranos, did some performance capture work on GTA 6, but the secrecy of the project meant he didn’t have much context for his scenes. Actors are often kept in the dark when playing a part in Rockstar games. When Roger Clark auditioned for Red Dead Redemption 2 , for example, the only clue he had at the time was he was told to wear cowboy boots. That secrecy, combined with the time between performance and the game’s release, hasn’t helped in Fortt’s case. “So, I was a motion capture actor on GTA 6, but I don’t know who the hell I am,” Fortt explained in a video that went viral on Instagram . “I auditioned about four or five years ago, they put the balls all over my body and face … and then I forgot all about it.” “Then I get a random email telling me that I’m in GTA 6. This is where I need your help.” Fortt, who is 63 years old and doesn't have a PS5 or play video games himself, is looking for help tracking the character down. According to the actor, his performance saw him standing behind a counter of some kind, and he interacted with Jason and Lucia at one point. He could be some kind of store clerk, a receptionist, or even a cop at a desk, judging by his description. It would be very funny if he ended up being a guard again, like in Jessica Jones and The Sopranos. The community is currently on the hunt for his character, but it might take a while. Rockstar put lots of work into making GTA 6 NPCs varied , hiring dozens and dozens of actors to breathe life into the citizens of Leonida. In a follow-up social media post on day two of the hunt, Fortt said 3 million people were looking for his character in the game, but no luck yet. I assume that's based on social media impressions to his various posts on this, rather than people actively looking for his character in the game. But still, he's caught quite a bit of attention for this. Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. sources.title: "Cyberpunk 2 is cancelled," says the RPG's director after entering a "GTA 6-induced" depression
sources.text: "Just a technological and creative miracle" Cyberpunk 2 creative director Igor Sarzyński is going through it on behalf of all open-world game developers on social media thanks to the release of GTA 6 . In a post on Bluesky, Sarzyński says, "GTA 6-induced-open-world-game-dev-depression is real." The Cyberpunk 2 director calls Rockstar Games ' latest "probably the single greatest artistic achievement in history," citing "scale, density, coherence, thoughtfulness of it all," adding its "just a technological and creative miracle." He then (hopefully) jokingly notes, "Cyberpunk 2 is cancelled, imma go sweep autumn leaves in my backyard now." GTAVI-induced-open-world-game-dev-depression is real. probably the single greatest artistic achievement in history, i mean it. scale, density, coherence, thoughtfulness of it all, just a technological and creative miracle. cyberpunk 2 is cancelled, imma go sweep autumn leaves in my backyard now. He follows this post up with a more serious take, saying, "I think we're doing something of our own, with a different unique flavor. GTA is impressive in a way all great art is, it expands what is possible, a captivating vision flawlessly executed." GTA 6 has inspired all sorts of praise from CD Projekt Red in general. Joint CEO Michał Nowakowski gave his congrats on launch day, while associate game director of Cyberpunk 2, Paweł Sasko, said that Rockstar has created what he calls a "generational banger." While I don't think CD Projekt will be one of them, there will undoubtedly be a ton of investors who don't quite understand game development asking why their company can't just make its own GTA 6 and sell over 30 million copies before it even launches – similarly to that time every company was trying to make its own Fortnite. But without access to the sheer amount of time and resources that Rockstar has because it's almost guaranteed to make that money back, a game on this scale simply isn't achievable for many. sources.title: Cyberpunk 2 creative director says he's suffering from 'GTA 6-induced-open-world-game-dev-depression,' jokes that 'Cyberpunk 2 is cancelled'
sources.text: It's been a big week for videogames—or rather, videogame. Grand Theft Auto 6 is enjoying what may very well be the single greatest media launch in history, securing over $3.7 billion in launch sales. But as Rockstar enjoys its acclaim, other developers—like Cyberpunk 2 creative director Igor Sarzynski—are professing some anxiety about releasing their own games in a post-GTA 6 world. "GTA 6-induced-open-world-game-dev-depression is real. Probably the single greatest artistic achievement in history, I mean it. Scale, density, coherence, thoughtfulness of it all, just a technological and creative miracle," Sarzynski said on Bluesky over the weekend, joking that "Cyberpunk 2 is cancelled." That news came as a surprise to Cyberpunk 2 lead writer Anna Megill, who replied with a baffled "But wait—" Sarzynski was, of course, just goofing. But I'm sympathetic to any game dev who might be feeling an amount of apprehension about being measured against GTA 6's success, particularly when there's a genre overlap. In Cyberpunk 2's case, however, CD Projekt is very much in its own lane: Cyberpunk is a different thematic setting, with entirely different systems and design goals. I'd hope that any reasonable person would think comparing the two is like comparing apples and oranges—particularly when the oranges reportedly had a production budget upwards of $1 billion . In a follow-up post , Sarzynski acknowledged that each project is doing its own thing, while noting that GTA 6's example will benefit other game developers by serving as a source of creative inspiration. "Seriously though, I think we're doing something of our own, with a different unique flavor," he said. "GTA is impressive in a way all great art is: It expands what is possible, a captivating vision flawlessly executed."
